author: ojiudezue
title: Config forms: collapsed sections (A) + visible= conditional fields (B) as one plan, gated on HA 2026.11 point release
summary: Advanced mode goes away (show_advanced_options forced True since 2026.10, removed 2027.6), so ~81 advanced fields need a new home.
why: A and B solve different problems: sections hide rarely used power, while visible= hides fields that do not apply. The operator wanted them planned together so they do not diverge. B needs HA 2026.11 plus a 2026.11 test harness, which does not exist yet, so nothing is built until the operator upgrades. Performance is a goal: a move-only save must cause zero reloads (INV-P). A build would have shipped one half and re-litigated the other.
implications: The plan is reviewed (rev 2, e8348bf8) and parked. INV-2 forbids hiding a value that still acts at runtime (sleep hours stay visible).
revisit_trigger: Operator upgrades to HA 2026.11.x and the pytest-homeassistant pin reaches 2026.11.
